findings.text: the threshold constants 5 and 3 are duplicated in the local CONFIG mirror (tests/test_coordinator_reserve.py:53-54) and in the shipped layer (reckon/schema/flight-defaults.yaml:84: coordinator_reserve_pct: 3), so a future default edit must touch both to keep the behaviour tests honest; the shipped-origin assertion at tests/test_flight.py:534 catches a drift in the value but nothing but convention keeps the arithmetic tests and the shipped defaults from splitting.

justifications.durability: five new tests in tests/test_coordinator_reserve.py plus an extended shipped-origin assertion at tests/test_flight.py:534 fail if the reserve stops resolving from shipped defaults, if a fresh dispatch is not held below a resume, or if the refusal stops naming the subtracted reserve.
justifications.evidence: all four quantitative done-when claims survive independent re-measurement at commit 5e3e041c: shipped origin/value tested at tests/test_coordinator_reserve.py:138-143, dispatch-held-where-resume-clears at line 147, refusal-naming at line 175, and the regen round-trip reproduced byte-identical by me from reckon/schema/flight.yaml.
justifications.fit: reckon/budget.py:213 withheld_reserves reuses the f"{value:g}% {label}" formatting and the UNSET_RESERVE_PCT convention of the existing resume_reserve_pct path at reckon/budget.py:194 effective_ceiling, so the coordinator reserve reads as a sibling of the resume reserve rather than a new idiom.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/budget.py:200 effective_ceiling subtracts coordinator_reserve_pct from the fresh-dispatch ceiling (100-5-3 = 92.0) while leaving the resume ceiling full, matching the node goal that a fresh dispatch is withheld by a declared reserve and a resume can spend it.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff's seven changed paths (reckon/schema/flight.yaml, reckon/schema/flight-defaults.yaml, reckon/_flight_schema.py, docs/_shared/flight.schema.json, reckon/budget.py, tests/test_coordinator_reserve.py, tests/test_flight.py) are exactly the seven declared write paths, with a clean worktree and no out-of-scope edits.
